title: A boundary of visibility
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The observable universe is limited by the light and other signals that have been able to reach us during cosmic history. That boundary is not known to be a physical wall.

misconception: A learner may choose: A physical wall at the edge of all space
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What does the boundary of the observable universe describe?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What does the boundary of the observable universe describe? A limit to what light has had time to reach us. The observable universe is limited by the light and other signals that have been able to reach us during cosmic history. That boundary is not known to be a physical wall.
Visual caption: Visibility has a horizon. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What does the boundary of the observable universe describe?
options: A physical wall at the edge of all space
The outer edge of the Milky Way
A limit to what light has had time to reach us
recall.why: The observable universe is limited by the light and other signals that have been able to reach us during cosmic history. That boundary is not known to be a physical wall.
